{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will enact measures to end partisan gerrymandering in federal elections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Efforts to redraw legislative districts following the 2020 Census must be guided by transparency and public input.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Redrawing legislative districts following the 2020 Census must reduce the power of partisan actors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Redrawn legislative districts must reflect the will of voters.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Redrawn legislative districts must fairly represent communities of color.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Redrawn legislative districts must provide for competitive races.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the integrity of the decennial Census from political interference.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Apportionment and redistricting must be based on total population counts.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Census Bureau must be equipped to conduct cost-effective, timely, and accurate surveys.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will maintain the legal requirement for Census participation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase resources to reduce undercounts of communities of color, immigrants, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, rural and low-income populations, and young children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Census Bureau will study whether counting the prison population where they are incarcerated creates inequitable outcomes in state or federal representation or funding allocations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase investments to help state and local governments upgrade election technology, including cybersecurity technology.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Election technology must be accessible for people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will increase oversight of private election vendors to ensure voting systems are secure and worthy of voters' trust.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will not tolerate election interference and will protect the integrity of elections from all enemies, foreign and domestic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
